baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal predication makes the saying an established condition; qawl supplies false attribution and held doctrine, while safah and shatat diagnose failed judgment and excess.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence makes the saying a sustained prior condition rather than an isolated slip.
False saying or attribution identifies speech wrongly predicated of God.
Qawl as belief or doctrine makes repeated speech an adopted position.
Lightness of mind and deficient forbearance supply the speaker's failed judgment.
Remoteness and excessive limit-crossing classify the doctrine as beyond warrant.

changed_reading.before: A foolish member once made a bad statement about God.
changed_reading.after: A group-associated fool maintained a recurring, falsely attributed doctrine whose claims exceeded their proper limit.

baseline_models.mechanism: The fool's lightness becomes unstable motion, while shatat supplies a wrong swerve and a crossed edge; utterance externalizes that displacement.

activation_trace.role: Lightness and unstable motion make foolishness a loss of directional stability.
Leaning away into injustice gives the unstable motion its wrong direction.
The side or bank supplies the boundary from which the utterance moves out.
Articulated speech makes the inward deviation publicly observable.

changed_reading.before: Shatat is an abstract label for error.
changed_reading.after: The utterance is a kinetic swerve: mental instability carries speech across a boundary and onto an unjust side.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَفِيهُنَا and the socially forceful branches of يَقُولُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The possessive locates the fool inside the group, while qawl's chief and judgment branches allow a positioned voice whose social force outruns its wisdom.

activation_trace.role: Place, position, or rank supplies a possible social location for the group's fool.
A titled chief whose word has force activates an influential spokesman.
Arrogating judgment turns that spokesman's speech into unauthorized authority.
Overreach measures the gap between social force and legitimate warrant.

changed_reading.before: The fool is merely one unintelligent group member.
changed_reading.after: The fool may be an internal spokesman whose forceful doctrinal judgment outruns his warrant.

baseline_models.mechanism: Talkativeness combines with safah's image of drinking repeatedly without satisfaction; shatat becomes appetite-driven verbal excess.

activation_trace.role: Being much given to speech supplies repeated verbal consumption and production.
Excessive drinking without quenching models speech as an unsatisfied appetite.
Excessive limit-crossing is the escalation produced by unquenched talk.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns one false proposition.
changed_reading.after: It can also diagnose an insatiable mode of speaking whose appetite keeps carrying it beyond restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening supplies a message sourced in divine communication, deliberately heard and recited. Against that chain, the fool's false attribution becomes counterfeit transmission rather than merely bad content.

activation_trace.role: News or inspiration from God supplies the authorized source.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns reception into accountable uptake.
Reading and recitation give the received message transmissible verbal form.
False attribution marks the fool's qawl as a rival claim without that chain.

structural_cues: 72:1 stages command, revelation, listening, reported hearing, and recitation before 72:4 reports the fool's saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sourced reception chain and a later false divine attribution; I infer a contrast between authorized reception and self-authorized speech. Alternatively, the sequence may contrast truth and falsehood without making provenance primary.

changed_reading.before: The saying is a recurring false doctrine.
changed_reading.after: The saying is also counterfeit transmission presented without the revelation-hearing-recitation chain that authorizes the opening report.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle direction toward an upright course produces settled trust, giving the focus ayah's unstable, leaning shatat an explicit countervector.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies directed movement.
Straightness of path away from error names the direction opposed to shatat.
The heart's repose in security and trust is the stable state produced by guidance.
Unstable motion supplies the contrary state.
Leaning into injustice supplies the contrary bearing.

structural_cues: 72:2 makes guidance toward rushd and resulting faith the immediate effects of hearing the Qur'an.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed guidance, upright course, settled trust, instability, and leaning; I align them as opposed vectors. A live alternative is a moral contrast without spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Shatat is crossed boundary in speech.
changed_reading.after: Shatat is the countercourse to rushd: unstable speech leans away from the route that heard guidance opens and trust stabilizes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine elevation and grandeur are followed by negated companion and offspring relations. The false attribution can therefore be read as crossing a category boundary by projecting creaturely relation and derivation onto God.

activation_trace.role: Elevation establishes the asymmetry that relational projection would collapse.
Greatness of rank intensifies the categorical distance.
Companionship and attachment supply one negated creaturely relation.
Something produced from another supplies the second negated relation.
False attribution connects relational projection to the fool's speech.
Limit-crossing becomes categorical trespass across divine-creature distance.

structural_cues: 72:3 negates companion and child immediately before 72:4 characterizes the fool's speech as shatat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, transcendence, and two negated relations; I infer that they exemplify the overreach. Alternatively, 72:4 may refer to a broader body of claims.

changed_reading.before: The fool utters unspecified excessive claims about God.
changed_reading.after: The excess can be categorical trespass: force-fitting divine transcendence into companionship, derivation, and creaturely kinship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The community reports a prior presumption that humans and jinn would not lie against God. The fool's circulating doctrine becomes the breach that exposes a failed social rule for trusting religious speech.

activation_trace.role: Confidence formed from an indication supplies the prior epistemic assurance.
False attribution identifies the speech they had treated as unthinkable.
Contrariety to truth states the failure disclosed by that presumption.
Circulating talk lets the doctrine exploit and reshape a shared trust environment.

structural_cues: 72:5 extends the failed presumption across humans and jinn and repeats saying against God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a generalized presumption and its falsification; I infer that this presumption screened false sacred speech from suspicion. Alternatively, 72:5 may record surprise without implying a transmission norm.

changed_reading.before: One influential fool maintained a false doctrine.
changed_reading.after: His doctrine is an epistemic shock revealing how communal confidence that no speaker would invent claims about God allowed false attribution to circulate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeking protection creates dependence, followed by increased burden. The socially forceful fool model gains a downstream institution: unauthorized sacred speech can recruit reliance and intensify what it promises to relieve.

activation_trace.role: Refuge and protection supply the dependent relation built around claimed authority.
Increase and growth provide the escalation produced by that relation.
Heavy imposed obligation specifies the escalation's harmful result.
The chief whose word has force anchors the mechanism in an effective speaker.
Deceptive turning-aside lets foolish authority redirect those seeking protection.

structural_cues: 72:6 pairs human men seeking refuge with jinn men and states that the relation increased rahaq.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dependence followed by increased burden; I infer that authoritative false discourse can legitimate the relation linking them. Alternatively, 72:6 may report a practice independent of the specific fool.

changed_reading.before: The fool is a forceful but verbally overreaching spokesman.
changed_reading.after: His kind of sacred claim can organize dependence: people seek protection under it while the authority produced by reliance increases burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Listening occurs from fixed surveillance stations at a guarded perimeter. Coupled with shatat's bank or side, this activates claims about God arising from contested, partial, or blocked access at an epistemic edge.

activation_trace.role: Auditory perception supplies the information sought at the perimeter.
Guarding establishes that access to the upper source is controlled.
Sitting in observation turns the listening places into surveillance stations.
Watchful guarding closes the contested route.
The edge or bank anchors the fool's speech at a boundary rather than the source.
Circulating report describes how fragmentary edge-information can become doctrine.

structural_cues: 72:8-9 move from touching the sky to guards, then recall former seats for hearing and present interception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies listening stations, a guarded boundary, and circulating speech; I infer a possible path from compromised access to overreaching report. Alternatively, the episode may explain the revelation setting but not the fool's claim.

changed_reading.before: The saying is false because its content crosses a semantic limit.
changed_reading.after: It may also be edge-produced knowledge: a public claim formed from unauthorized or fragmentary listening at a guarded boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers suspend judgment about whether evil or right guidance is intended, and the commissioned speaker later repeats that he does not know the promised time. Shatat becomes epistemic trespass into divine intention.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge is explicitly negated, establishing disciplined uncertainty.
The later disclaimer extends restraint even to the commissioned speaker.
Will and intention identify the divine domain about which they refuse to overclaim.
Correctly hitting an affair's proper face remains a possible intention, not asserted knowledge.
Arrogating judgment describes the opposite posture.
Overreach becomes overstatement about concealed purpose and timing.

structural_cues: 72:10 balances possible intentions with 'we do not know'; 72:25 places the same disclaimer inside an imperative to say.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit ignorance beside divine intention and timing; I infer that the fool violates that calibrated restraint. Alternatively, his attribution may concern relations rather than intention or future knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The fool says something falsely attributed to God.
changed_reading.after: His shatat is epistemic sovereignty: he speaks decisively where even corrected and commissioned speakers mark what they do not know.

context_deltas.mechanism: The group describes itself as internally mixed and distributed among divergent paths. This localizes 'our fool' as an internal voice or factional doctrine rather than the essence of the whole community.

activation_trace.role: Soundness opposed to corruption establishes positive members in the same group.
An extended route supplies durable subgroup orientations.
Divergent paths and separated parties make internal plurality explicit.
Qawl as doctrine lets the possessive fool represent one internal path's position.

structural_cues: 72:11 repeats 'among us' for the sound and those below that, then describes divergent paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies internal moral variety and separated paths; I infer that 'our fool' can denote a faction-bearing voice. Alternatively, it may be one literal individual with no subgroup behind him.

changed_reading.before: The possessive marks a group's embarrassing spokesman.
changed_reading.after: The possessive can perform self-critical boundary work: one internal path's doctrine is rejected without flattening the whole group.

context_deltas.mechanism: Straightness on an extended road is opposed to turning one's side from remembrance and being inserted into an arduous ascent. The focus utterance becomes the verbal first motion of route departure.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and balance supply the correct directional posture.
The extended road gives straightness a traversable course.
Turning the side away initiates departure from remembrance.
Proceeding in a road converts orientation into an entered trajectory.
A difficult ascent supplies the deviating route's terminal shape.
Unstable motion supplies susceptibility to leave the straight route.
Leaning away makes spoken deviation the first wrong bearing.

structural_cues: 72:16-17 sequence straightness on the path, turning away, entry into a course, and arduous ascent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a route sequence and the focus supplies unstable leaning; I infer that speech orientation can initiate lived direction. Alternatively, this may be spatial echo without a causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Shatat is a spatial metaphor for a bad statement.
changed_reading.after: The statement is route-forming: verbal leaning begins a departure later embodied as turning aside and traversing a punishing ascent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated commissioned speech defines its limits: call the Lord, disclaim possession of harm or right direction, and restrict the office to conveying messages. The fool converts transmission into possession and judgment.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech under an imperative supplies commissioned utterance.
Calling by speech defines the commissioned speaker's stated act.
Ownership and disposal are disclaimed, limiting claimed control.
Delivering a message sets transmission as the proper function.
Messenger and message bind utterance to an office and received payload.
Arrogating judgment names the improper authority assumed by the fool.
Overreach measures the move from delivery to self-authorized control.

structural_cues: 72:20-23 repeat 'Say,' narrow the call, disclaim power, and identify conveyance and messages as the role.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commissioned speech, a power disclaimer, and a conveyance-only office; I infer that these define the focus boundary. Alternatively, the later disclaimers may answer a different audience and illuminate the fool indirectly.

changed_reading.before: The fool's statement is wrong in content and confidence.
changed_reading.after: It usurps speaking office by turning received-message authority into personal possession, efficacy, or judgment about God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending makes disclosure selective, routes it through a messenger, guards the path, verifies arrival, and encloses the process in comprehensive knowledge. The focus qawl becomes a chain-of-custody violation.

activation_trace.role: Concealment from sight establishes the protected information domain.
Disclosure defines controlled movement from concealment into visibility.
The messenger and message supply selected carrier and bounded payload.
Passage along a route gives disclosure a traceable path.
Watching and guarding protect that path.
Delivery supplies the verifiable endpoint of the guarded route.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and custody closes the chain.
False attribution is an unverified payload that bypasses the chain.
Overreach becomes unauthorized passage across the disclosure perimeter.

structural_cues: 72:26 restricts disclosure; 72:27 guards the selected messenger before and behind; 72:28 verifies delivery and enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selective disclosure, routed custody, guarding, delivery, and encompassing knowledge; I infer a provenance criterion for the focus claim. Alternatively, the ending may regulate revelation specifically while the fool's claim is ordinary theological invention.

changed_reading.before: The fool's saying counterfeits a revealed and heard message.
changed_reading.after: It violates the full chain of custody by crossing from a protected domain without selected carrier, guarded route, verified delivery, or warrant.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it activates safah's property-deception branch inside theological speech; valid through سَفِيهُنَا plus contextual burden and diminution. Render only as an exploratory social-effect analogy, not a claim that 72:4 literally describes monetary fraud.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَفِيهُنَا as one who turns another aside by deception

activation_trace.role: Deceptive diversion from property activates an extractive function for foolish sacred speech.
Heavy imposed obligation supplies the burden produced in dependence.
Diminution of due right or value supplies the threatened loss.
Blameworthy oppressive or foolish excess reconnects burden to the focus diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: The fool's defect is cognitive and verbal.
changed_reading.after: His God-talk may function extractively, diverting dependents into arrangements that diminish their due and increase burden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Branch-distant because it models speech through safah's unquenched drinking image; valid through يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا and later abundant water. Qualify it as an appetite analogy, not a lexical translation of safīh.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا with safah's drinking-without-satiety branch

activation_trace.role: Being much given to speech supplies the repeated appetite-like act.
Excessive drinking without quenching supplies unsatisfied reception and speech.
Giving drink supplies the offered answer to unquenched appetite.
Water gives the appetite image concrete contextual material.
Abundance shows the defect may be incapacity for satiety rather than scarcity.
Excessive limit-crossing is what unsatisfied verbal appetite produces.

changed_reading.before: The fool speaks too far because he lacks information.
changed_reading.after: He may speak too far because his mode of reception cannot be quenched, converting abundance into further appetite and excess.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping; valid through the shared mapped root and later exact ق ل ل beside counting. Render only as split-root resonance about unsupported magnitude, never as the lexical gloss of يَقُولُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَقُولُ through packet-supplied root_001251, contained by شَطَطًا

activation_trace.role: The split target's fewness casts a faint shadow of scant support beneath the large claim.
The later exact root names fewness and activates the non-dominant focus mapping.
Counting makes the claim's backing measurable rather than rhetorically inflated.
Overreach supplies the mismatch between expansive assertion and scant support.

changed_reading.before: The saying is large because it exceeds a boundary.
changed_reading.after: At the split-root edge, its overreach is inflated speech resting on support that is few, countable, and weak.

strongest_changes: Qawl changed from merely false content into counterfeit transmission bypassing a revealed, heard, commissioned, and guarded message chain.
Shatat changed from abstract excess into the countervector to rushd and the first verbal motion of route departure.
The fool changed from isolated simpleton into a possible internal spokesman whose claims exploit trust and organize burdensome dependence.
Divine elevation beside negated companion and offspring relations made categorical divine-creature trespass a live specification of overreach.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly joined speech to source, hearing, route, restraint, office, guarding, and verified arrival. Provenance and directional geometry therefore became more diagnostic than flat true-versus-false classification, while safah and split-root branches preserved stranger appetite, extraction, and fewness activations.
remaining_uncertainties: 72:3 may specify the fool's claim or provide only one adjacent correction.
The guarded listening episode may explain old claims or only the changed setting of the newly heard Qur'an.
The singular possessive fool may be leader, factional voice, or literal member; social authority remains inferred.
Extraction, unquenched drinking, and split-root fewness are contained branch activations, not lexical substitutions.
